items.topic: Path pervades consciousness and outer forms
items.gist: The whole path rests in consciousness and thereby in inner and outer loci. It appears both as a totality and in distributed parts, sequentially or all at once.
At each level of the path one's own form should shine freely in fitting form. Nothing's form is excluded anywhere, even in dream.

items.topic: Body as universe and identity with seen objects
items.gist: The body is beheld as filled with the universe-path and made of deities. Whatever is seen anywhere should be approached through identity with it.

items.topic: Worship, japa, meditation, homa, vow as absorption
items.gist: Offering through non-difference is worship, full-formed contemplation is meditation, and fire-rite melts self-difference. Together with vow and rule, these constitute the complete state called absorption.

In these practices there is no rule or prohibition regarding materials, and no need for visualization or purification rites. Whatever accords with one's gracious consciousness is the rule, and all worldly or unworldly things may be employed.

items.topic: Overcoming tremor, doubt, and forbidden offerings
items.gist: The unsteady practitioner should forcibly reduce tremor and strive until doubt dissolves. Goddesses in mind, rite, and senses are libated with forbidden things, since mantras and substances are not truly mixed.
Doubt is to be disregarded and dissolves, as taught across the scriptures and traditions. The path is praised as the thunderbolt to all doubt, leading to the anuttara state.
